title: Decoded edges are matching graph edges
statement: Let $m$ be a natural number and let $c$ be a perfect-matching code of order $m$. If $(a,b)$ occurs in the list decoded from $c$ and the list $[0,1,\ldots,2m-1]$, then $a<2m$ and $b<2m$, and the vertices represented by $a$ and $b$ are adjacent in the perfect-matching graph determined by $c$.
hypotheses_covered: The pair $(a,b)$ belongs to the decoded list
